description: Play a sprite sheet as a GIF or animated WebP: choose the grid, frame order, speed, ping-pong and a crisp whole-number upscale. For checking a walk cycle with your eyes, and for store pages, devlogs and READMEs. Price: $0.02 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Sprite tools: 2D sprite jobs for games: cut sprites out of their background (exact for one-color backgrounds, AI for busy ones), turn animation videos into aligned sprite sheets, make normal maps for 2D lights, build 47-tile autotile sets with Tiled, Godot and Unity rules, slice a sheet into frames, pack frames into an atlas with TexturePacker and Unity metadata, and turn upscaled or AI-generated pixel art into real pixel art on its true grid with a limited palette..

cols.description: Columns of equal cells in the sheet.

count.description: Frames to use when the last row is not full.

image.description: Base64 PNG or WebP with transparency.

order.description: Play these cell indexes in this order (0 is top left), for example [0,1,2,1].

scale.description: Whole-number upscale with hard pixels. Chosen to make the preview about 256 px when omitted.

name: sprite_tools_animate
